[Problem]{.card-kicker} **list the root-to-leaf paths** [LC 257 · Binary Tree Paths](https://leetcode.com/problems/binary-tree-paths/){difficulty="Easy"}

The text of the path is the state. A leaf emits it. Passing a new string down copies the whole path at every node. One shared list, with the node pushed before the children and popped after them, copies each path only when a leaf emits it.
